caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular frame with ornate decorative elements in a light brown or sepia tone on a beige background. At the top center of the frame, there is a circular target with concentric rings. Behind the target, two rifles are crossed diagonally. On each side of the target, there are small wheels with spokes, and additional decorative flourishes resembling ribbon or garland patterns. The corners of the frame are detailed with subtle curved accents. At the bottom center of the frame, a cartouche contains stylized, serif letters "U C S D" separated by small dots. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying intensities of the same brownish hue to create lines, shading, and highlights. The interior of the frame is empty and unadorned.
title: Picture Frame
